label: Half Hidden Placket
description: The Half Hidden placket is a hybrid construction: the upper portion of the button strip is concealed behind a fold while the lower section is left visible as a conventional plain placket. This creates a subtle transition in formality down the shirt front — more formal and clean at the chest where it is most visible under a jacket, more casual toward the waist. It is a particularly versatile choice for shirts that will be worn both tucked with a jacket and untucked on casual occasions.
